one_liner: QuickBooks Online has a broad REST accounting API with self-serve OAuth 2.0 and a free developer account, sandbox and free Builder tier. Production use needs an app assessment.
auth_notes: Authorization-code OAuth 2.0 per company (realmId). Access token lasts 60 minutes. Refresh token is rolling, with a 5-year hard max.
access_notes: A free Intuit developer account gives a client ID and secret plus free sandbox companies. The free Builder tier includes 500k CorePlus credits a month. Production needs an app assessment.
blocker_notes: Builder tier reads are capped at 500k credits a month and calls are blocked above that. Production keys require an app assessment, but dev and sandbox work is immediate.

evidence.quote: Each of your clients' QuickBooks Online companies will need to individually connect and authorize your app through OAuth 2.0, since access is scoped per company
This generates your client ID and client secret, plus a free sandbox company for testing.
full CRUD operations for 29 entity types and 11 financial reports, giving you comprehensive access to QuickBooks Online functionality.
this is a local MCP server. It runs as a stdio subprocess on the developer's or partner's machine and authenticates to a QuickBooks Online company.
